description: Source code for CLIInstaller utility in Swift, managing installation and location detection of the openclaw CLI tool.

classes.name: CLIInstaller
classes.description: Enum providing static methods for managing the installation and location of the openclaw CLI tool.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Returns the file path of the installed openclaw CLI if present.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the openclaw CLI is installed.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of the openclaw CLI, updating status via a handler.
